extraction.document_summary: FWD Life PA is a guaranteed renewable personal accident insurance plan underwritten by FWD Singapore Pte. Ltd. Coverage is guaranteed renewability “until the person insured reaches age 100” as long as premiums are paid on time. The base structure is built around 3 plan types linked to ADDB (Accidental Death and Disability Benefit) sum insured of S$100,000 / S$200,000 / S$500,000, with Accidental Death (100% of ADDB sum insured) and Accidental Permanent Disability (up to 150% of ADDB sum insured). It also provides Double and Triple Indemnity on accidental death/permanent disability in defined travel/transport scenarios, plus Compassionate Grant (10% of ADDB sum insured). It pays inpatient and outpatient accident-related medical expenses (per accident limits) with sub-limits for Chinese physician/acupuncturist/bonesetter/chiropractor and physiotherapy, expiring when the person insured turns age 80. Optional riders include a Catch-All ICU add-on (extra 10% of ADDB) and Income Support Rider (daily/weekly hospital income with plan-specific amounts and age/group halving rules).
quality_notes: Product name, core benefits, plan types, and rider benefit mechanics are stated with numeric limits and explicit age/expiry conditions.
Underwriting method, entry age limits, grace period, free-look period, surrender/cash value details are only partially provided (free-look is mentioned; other items are not).
Exclusions are referenced only generically; no specific excluded causes/conditions are listed.

policies.quick_summary: Guaranteed renewable personal accident plan with ADDB-based accidental death/permanent disability payouts, inpatient & outpatient accident medical expenses (with age-80 expiry), and Double/Triple Indemnity in defined travel/transport scenarios. Optional riders add ICU-based extra 10% and daily/weekly hospital income for accidental hospitalization/temporary total disability with plan-specific rates and halving rules for certain groups/ages (as stated). Lifetime 10% No Claim Discount applies to premiums (incl. riders, if applicable). Coverage is guaranteed renewable until age 100 as long as premiums are paid on time.
coverage_scope: Inpatient and outpatient medical expenses from accidents
Enhanced indemnity (double/triple) for defined travel/transport circumstances
policies.eligibility_notes: The brochure states worldwide protection and that medical expenses can be incurred in or outside Singapore, and it includes group definitions for income-rider halving (children, unemployed, and ages). It does not state other eligibility criteria.
policies.coverage_term_description: Guaranteed renewability until the person insured reaches age 100 (renewability described as long as premiums are paid on time).
policies.renewal_basis: Guaranteed renewability until the person insured reaches age 100.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Lifetime 10% No Claim Discount described as applied on premiums after three consecutive claim-free years.
policy_termination_events: Policy premiums not paid on time (coverage remains active as long as premiums are paid on time).
In compliance with sanctions/AML/counter-terrorism financing, FWD may end the policy and related cover and treat premiums/amounts payable in any manner they deem appropriate.
important_caveats: Medical expenses must be incurred within 12 months from the date of the accident; inpatient/outpatient treatment benefit expires when the person insured turns age 80.

Income Support Rider limits can be halved for certain groups (children age 21 and under, unemployed persons, and persons aged 80 and over for Daily Hospital Income Benefit; children age 21 and under and unemployed persons for Weekly Income Benefit) and the Weekly Income Benefit expires when the person insured turns age 75.
The brochure references pre-existing conditions and exclusions, whereby no benefits will be payable, but does not list specific exclusions.
